text:
```yaml
name: Mark stale documentation issues and PRs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 1 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/stale@v9
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-issue-message: |
            This documentation issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs. Thank you for your contributions.
            
            For ServiceNow integration documentation updates, please see the related PR: docs: add ServiceNow integration setup guide (ext-364)
          stale-pr-message: |
            This documentation pull request has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs. Thank you for your contributions.
            
            Related to: docs: add ServiceNow integration setup guide (ext-364)
          close-issue-message: |
            Closing this documentation issue as it has been marked as stale and no further activity has occurred. 
            
            For ServiceNow integration documentation, see: docs: add ServiceNow integration setup guide (ext-364)
          close-pr-message: |
            Closing this documentation pull request as it has been marked as stale and no further activity has occurred.
            
            Related to: docs: add ServiceNow integration setup guide (ext-364)
          days-before-stale: 30
          days-before-close: 7
          exempt-issue-labels: documentation,good first issue,help wanted
          exempt-pr-labels: documentation,good first issue,help wanted
          stale-issue-label: stale
          stale-pr-label: stale
          operations-per-run: 100
```
